name: Amouage
note: Luxury niche, not a dupe house: Amouage is from Oman but sits at Creed and Xerjoff prices, and several Arabian houses copy it. Men's and women's scents are named Man and Woman; the newer ranges are unisex and appear on both tabs. Reflection 45 (8.8) and Reflection Man (8.6 from 6,733) lead. Only Amouage's 40 most popular scents could be read from Parfumo.
